description: Test whether absence of classical NLS and low Ser density are conserved across Gat2 orthologs
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ORTH={"S.cerevisiae Gat2":"P40209","C.glabrata":"Q6FR51","Z.rouxii":"C5DQ45",
      "E.gossypii":"Q759M7","K.lactis":"Q6CJP0","N.castellii":"C5DI42"}
NCR={"Sc Gln3":"P18494","Sc Gat1":"P43574","Sc Dal80":"P26343","Sc Gzf3":"P42944"}
def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
O={k:fa(v) for k,v in ORTH.items()}; N={k:fa(v) for k,v in NCR.items()}

BAS=set("KR")
def mono(s): return [(m.start()+1,s[m.start():m.start()+4]) for m in re.finditer(r"(?=[KR][KR].[KR])",s)]
def bip(s):
    out=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?=[KR][KR])",s):
        i=m.start()
        for g in range(9,13):
            j=i+2+g; seg=s[j:j+5]
            if len(seg)==5 and sum(c in BAS for c in seg)>=3: out.append((i+1,s[i:j+5])); break
    return out
def clusters(s,w=20,thr=7):
    h=[(i+1,i+w) for i in range(len(s)-w+1) if sum(c in BAS for c in s[i:i+w])>=thr]
    o=[]
    for a,b in h:
        if o and a<=o[-1][1]: o[-1][1]=max(o[-1][1],b)
        else: o.append([a,b])
    return o

print("=== NLS-motif conservation across Gat2 orthologs vs NCR GATA factors ===")
rows=[]
for lbl,s in list(O.items())+list(N.items()):
    grp="Gat2 ortholog" if lbl in O else "NCR GATA"
    rows.append(dict(group=grp,protein=lbl,length=len(s),pct_KR=round(100*sum(c in BAS for c in s)/len(s),1),
        pct_S=round(100*s.count("S")/len(s),1),
        classical_NLS=len(mono(s)), bipartite=len(bip(s)), basic_clusters=len(clusters(s)),
        KR_run4=len(re.findall(r"[KR]{4,}",s)),
        AThook=len(re.findall(r"[KR]G[KR]P",s))+len(re.findall(r"RGRP",s))))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(T.to_string(index=False))
print("\nGroup means:")
print(T.groupby("group")[["pct_KR","pct_S","classical_NLS","basic_clusters","KR_run4"]].mean().round(2).to_string())

print("\n=== conservation of the ScGat2 411-430 basic/AT-hook patch (RGRPR) ===")
for lbl,s in O.items():
    hits=[(m.start()+1,s[max(0,m.start()-10):m.start()+12]) for m in re.finditer(r"RG[RK]P",s)]
    print(f"  {lbl:22s} RG[RK]P hits: {hits if hits else 'NONE'}")

print("\n=== Ser-rich tract test: longest window with >=30% Ser (w=50) ===")
for lbl,s in list(O.items())+list(N.items()):
    best=0;pos=0
    for i in range(len(s)-50+1):
        f=100*sum(c=="S" for c in s[i:i+50])/50
        if f>best: best,pos=f,i+1
    print(f"  {lbl:22s} max Ser% in 50aa = {best:5.1f}  at {pos}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.2))
g=T.groupby("group")
ax[0].bar([0,1],[g["classical_NLS"].mean()["Gat2 ortholog"],g["classical_NLS"].mean()["NCR GATA"]],
          color=["#C1553B","#2F5D8C"],width=0.55)
for i,gn in enumerate(["Gat2 ortholog","NCR GATA"]):
    v=T[T.group==gn]["classical_NLS"].values
    ax[0].scatter(np.full(len(v),i)+np.linspace(-0.12,0.12,len(v)),v,color="k",s=22,zorder=3)
ax[0].set_xticks([0,1]); ax[0].set_xticklabels(["Gat2 orthologs\n(n=6)","NCR GATA factors\n(n=4)"])
ax[0].set_ylabel("classical (K/R)(K/R)X(K/R) NLS motifs")
ax[0].set_title("Classical importin-alpha NLS motif count",fontsize=11,loc="left")
ax[1].scatter(T[T.group=="Gat2 ortholog"]["pct_KR"],T[T.group=="Gat2 ortholog"]["pct_S"],color="#C1553B",s=70,label="Gat2 orthologs")
ax[1].scatter(T[T.group=="NCR GATA"]["pct_KR"],T[T.group=="NCR GATA"]["pct_S"],color="#2F5D8C",s=70,label="NCR GATA")
for _,r in T.iterrows(): ax[1].annotate(r.protein.replace("S.cerevisiae ","Sc "),(r.pct_KR,r.pct_S),fontsize=7,xytext=(3,3),textcoords="offset points")
ax[1].set_xlabel("K+R content (%)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("serine content (%)")
ax[1].set_title("Gat2 orthologs are not Ser-rich, unlike Gln3 and Gat1",fontsize=11,loc="left")
ax[1].legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9)
for a in ax:
    for sp in ("top","right"): a.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
